subtitle: "Tentative Calendar - Spring 2026"
execute:
  freeze: true
format: 
  html: default
  pdf: 
    pdf-engine: lualatex
    mainfont: "Palatino"
editor: 
  markdown: 
    wrap: 72
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(googlesheets4)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
gs4_deauth()
d <- read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AyvpFMtNRidAAaTjZ-iSJXE7VpgHBSRauv_TtiFEF_Y/edit?usp=sharing")

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

options(gt.html_tag_check = FALSE)

d |>
  select(week, dow, date, `reference reading`, topic, due) |>
  rowwise() |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_date(date, date_style = 30) |>
  sub_missing(columns = c(week, dow, date, `reference reading`, topic, due), missing_text = "") |>
  cols_align(
    align = "center", 
    columns = c(week)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "right", 
    columns = c(date)
  ) |>
  cols_align(
    align = "left", 
    columns = c(topic, `reference reading`, due)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "right",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      style = "solid"
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = c(date, topic, `reference reading`, due)
    )
  ) |>
  fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(topic, `reference reading`, due)
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    week ~ px(45),
    dow ~ px(30),
    date ~ px(50), 
    `reference reading` ~ px(150),
    topic ~ px(200),
    due ~ px(150)
  ) |>
  cols_label_with(fn = function(x) {
      janitor::make_clean_names(x, case = "title") |>
        toupper() |>
        stringr::str_replace_all("^|$", "**") |>
        md()
    }) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = 13) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```
